end-every-week-score-important-retrospec: At the end of every week, we must score it. It is important to do a retrospective on the week, see what went wrong and opportunities to improve. It is also important to track you leading and lagging indicators for the week to see if there is an issue with our planning and execution framework. For this, keep a weekly scorecard that tracks task accomplishment and habit consistency. If you have lagging indicators, track these as well. Add any action items that result from incomplete or previous work to this or other weeks, or add a new goal to be addressed at a later date. Finally, review your vision and aspirational goals to make sure we don't lose track of the purpose of each goal.
order-make-sure-tracking-towards-goal-ne: In order to make sure that we are tracking towards our goal we need feedback mechanisms. These are accomplished via goal review at different time intervals, from the daily reviews, where we track our daily activities, to the annual review, where we make sure our vision, domains, areas and values still make sense.
once-domains-identified-areas-defined-va: Once your Domains are identified, your Areas defined and your [[Values]] selected, then you can start creating goals. Just like your life vision describes your ideal life, aspirational goals describe actions that you need to take in order to bridge the gap between where you are now and what your vision describes.
determine-essential-pursue-relentless: One should determine what is essential and pursue it with relentless determination. Lve by design, not by default and make choices deliberately. Prioritize your life so that others don't do it for you.
being-able-work-smartly-others-clear-goa: Being able to work smartly with others, with clear goals and in a way that allows me to influence and be influenced by others is an opportunity for growth and fulfillment.
rational-beings-happiness-achievable-liv: We are rational beings and happiness is only achievable by living according to our nature which consists in the pursuit of wisdom, justice, temperance and courage.
